text:
Stephanie Nguyen: Can we please get a *single link* to “latest security kit” we can send internally / drop in Slack? I’m bouncing between 3 Drive PDFs + an old Confluence page and it’s a mess. Customers asking for SOC2 + retention + audit logs stuff and I don’t want to accidentally send outdated.

Jordan Blake: +1. Field keeps pinging me for “the link”. We need one canonical place + permissions story.

Markus Klein: Agree. Also important: Confluence pages are great as source of truth, but AEs need a *field-ready packet* (PDF) they can attach / forward.

Naomi Feldman: Yep, this is exactly what we’re trying to fix with the enablement kit refresh. Question: where should the “one link” point?
- Option A: Confluence (canonical) with links out to the PDFs
- Option B: Drive folder (PDFs) with a pointer back to Confluence

Isabelle Laurent: For CRM/HubSpot, a stable URL is key. Drive links tend to get re-shared and permissions drift. Confluence has better “canonical + version” behavior but we need to ensure Sales/SE access by default.

Elliot Price: From docs/publishing perspective: Confluence should be canonical. We can put a banner at top: “Download latest PDFs here” linking to a Drive folder. But the *entry point* should be Confluence.

Stephanie Nguyen: Works for me as long as it’s easy to find and I’m not blocked by perms mid-call.

Olga Petrov: +1 to Confluence entry point. Also: we need to *avoid* having customers stumble into restricted content. Drive sharing gets risky fast (people toggle “anyone with link”). Confluence internal page + controlled external sharing of PDFs is safer.

Daniel Carter: For evidence specifically (SOC 2 report, pen test summary), we can’t have those in the same “kit” link if it’s going to get forwarded. We should keep the kit as “safe-to-share under NDA when approved” and route evidence requests through the SOP.

Markus Klein: Can we do something like:
1) Confluence page: “Security Enablement Kit (Latest)” — internal only
2) Drive folder: “Security Kit v2 - Field PDFs” — internal only, no external share
3) Separate: evidence request process link + who to ask

Naomi Feldman: That’s the model I prefer. Confluence = source of truth + versioning + changelog. Drive = exported PDFs only.

Lukas Meyer: EMEA note: prospects constantly ask “can you send this now” and we’re on Zoom. If Drive folder is internal-only, how do we share the PDFs with customers?

Olga Petrov: We should not be using “anyone with the link” Drive sharing. For customer sharing, either:
- attach the PDF to the email (preferred), or
- share via approved method after NDA (depends on artifact)
For the one-pagers + FAQ PDF it’s generally okay to email the PDF. SOC 2 report access is a separate gated flow.

Jasmine Liu: From CS side, same issue on renewals. Having one internal link where we can grab the latest PDFs is perfect. We’ll send PDFs as attachments.

Isabelle Laurent: If we’re aligning on Confluence as entry point, I can add a single “Security Enablement Kit (Latest)” link into HubSpot playbooks + the default security review task template.

Elliot Price: I can also set up a Confluence “short link” / redirect so it’s easy to paste. Something like `go/security-kit` (if we have go-links) or a memorable Confluence short URL.

Jordan Blake: We do have go-links. Let’s do `go/security-kit`.

Naomi Feldman: Action items:
- Elliot: create/refresh Confluence landing page (internal) + include:
  - links to latest PDFs (FAQ v2 + one-pagers pack)
  - link to evidence request SOP (restricted) + note “do not forward”
  - “last reviewed” + owner (me)
- Isabelle: add `go/security-kit` to HubSpot + pin in #sales resources
- Olga/Daniel: confirm the wording on what can be shared without routing through GRC (basically: FAQ + one-pagers are OK; SOC2 report requires NDA + approval)

Markus Klein: Also recommend a small callout on the Confluence page: “Confluence is source of truth; PDFs are exports for customer sharing.” People keep editing the PDFs and it gets weird.

Elliot Price: Yep. I’ll add a banner and a “do not edit PDFs / export only” note. Also can add the current version stamp (e.g., v2.0, date) in the footer.

Stephanie Nguyen: Can we pin the link in #sales once it’s live? :pray:

Jordan Blake: We’ll pin it + I’ll mention in Monday standup.

Naomi Feldman: Cool. Targeting EOW for the landing page and go-link. I’ll drop the link here as soon as it’s ready.

Isabelle Laurent: When it’s ready, please confirm the Drive folder permissions (Sales + Solutions Engineering + CS). I’ll mirror the same list in HubSpot notes so people stop requesting access.

Olga Petrov: Reminder: please do *not* include SOC 2 report link directly on the landing page. Just link to the request process.

Naomi Feldman: Agreed.

Markus Klein: Thanks all. This will reduce so much thrash.

Elliot Price: I’ll start a draft today and loop Naomi for review. :thumbsup:

Jordan Blake: :thumbsup: :thumbsup:
